description: Main implementation of a Bluetooth audio source recorder that captures audio stream and writes it to a WAV file, handling sink configuration, acquisition, relinquishing, and state changes.

classes.name: context_t
classes.description: Holds context information for the recording session, including file details, format, and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: wav_header_t
classes.description: Represents the WAV file header structure used for writing audio data.

methods.name: on_configure_sink
methods.description: Configures the sink with the provided audio format, caching parameters.

methods.name: on_acquire_sink
methods.description: Handles acquisition of the sink, creating and writing the WAV header to the output file.

methods.name: on_relinquish_sink
methods.description: Handles relinquishing the sink, finalizing the WAV file by updating header sizes and closing the file.

methods.name: on_change_sink_speed
methods.description: Handles changes in sink playback speed, starting or stopping recording accordingly.

methods.name: on_get_time
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current recorded time in milliseconds.

methods.name: on_get_delay
methods.description: Returns zero delay samples, as this is a disk writer.

methods.name: on_frame_received
methods.description: Writes received audio frames to the output WAV file if recording is active.

methods.name: state_changed
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth source state changes, logs current state.

methods.name: operational_state_update
methods.description: Callback for operational state updates, registers or unregisters callbacks based on service availability.

methods.name: ctrl_c_handler
methods.description: Handles SIGINT (Ctrl+C) to set a flag for stopping recording.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that initializes Bluetooth audio source, manages connection, recording loop, and cleanup.
